bundle.shortDescription: Self-contained Windows desktop downloader for Facebook Videos, Reels, Watch streams, and permitted posts
bundle.longDescription: FlowFB is a commercial-grade, self-contained Windows desktop application built on Tauri v2 and Rust that manages standalone yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and gallery-dl binaries to download Facebook Videos, Reels, Watch streams, and multi-media posts in up to 4K/60fps.
